svg.title: Collection and lifecycle — evidence before persistence
svg.desc: Search YAML selects discovery scope, not publication eligibility. Authorized bounded HTTP supplies guest cards and details. After normalization the deterministic classifier produces accepted records. Successful searches persist independently; failed searches record diagnostics only. The separate full-state availability audit uses explicit evidence and preserves inconclusive rows.
